_comment: Copy this to config.json inside your recording folder and edit. Tells the pipeline how to process this recording. See docs/SUITE2P_SETTINGS.md for how to pick native_fps and indicator.
_indicator_options: SS9 jGCaMP8s | SS10 jGCaMP8f | Fluo-4 AM | Fluo-4 (mp4)
_native_fps_help: True frame rate from the TIF timestamps, NOT the Suite2p GUI default.
_route_options: cascade_gc8s (jGCaMP8s -> downsample 45Hz + CASCADE GC8s) | cascade_gc8f (jGCaMP8f) | dff (Fluo-4 dye -> dF/F event detection, no CASCADE)
